submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on closed-class function words in complement and modifier positions, most strongly object pronouns (' it', ' them', ' him', ' me', ' us'), demonstrative and quantifier determiners (' this', ' each', ' both', ' same', ' every', ' all', ' other', ' a', ' an'), possessive determiners (' their', ' my', ' our'), degree, time and manner adverbs (' very', ' always', ' together', ' Suddenly', ' finally', ' ever', ' much', ' until', ' even', ' really'), and exclamation '!' and contracted negation fragments (' don', ' didn', ' wouldn'). It stays quiet on open-class content words (nouns, lexical verbs, adjectives, proper names) and on subject pronouns, copulas, conjunctions and the preposition ' of'. Token identity explains 74% of activation variance and the peak token itself drives the activation, while the vocabulary lens is incoherent, so there is no lookahead signal.
